description: Lists the APIs on Datacircle's sheet and the number of plans and providers for each. Pass an API's name to search_plans. list_apis takes no arguments. The answer holds every API on the sheet, in the sheet's order, with no paging. Each API comes with a link to the API's sheet. Some APIs also link a best page. A best page ranks the API's providers on our benchmark. Call list_apis first when you don't know an API's name. The tool is free and read-only, and needs no key.
name: list_apis

apis.description: Every API on the sheet, in its order.

api.description: The API's name, the api search_plans takes.

bestPage.description: The API's best page on datacircle.dev, which ranks its providers on our benchmark. Left out where it has none.

plans.description: How many plans the API has on the sheet.

sheetPage.description: The API's sheet on datacircle.dev: its plans and their prices.

title: List the APIs
